articles.summary: AUSTIN, Texas, May 07, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Open Lending Corporation (Nasdaq: LPRO) (the “Company” or “Open Lending”), a leading provider of lending enablement and risk analytics solutions for financial institutions, today reported financial results for its first quarter ended March 31, 2026.
articles.title: Open Lending Reports First Quarter 2026 Financial Results
